confirm.description: AquaNode Pulse was found automatically at {host}. Enter the setup password printed on the product label.

manual.title: Add AquaNode Pulse manually
manual.description: Use this only when Home Assistant and Pulse are separated by a VLAN that blocks mDNS.

pick.title: Choose your AquaNode Pulse
pick.description: These boards answered on your network. Pick the one you want to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Update authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the setup password printed on the AquaNode Pulse label.

calibrate.description: Measure the outlet at this moment with a safe true-RMS multimeter and enter that value. Do not adjust the module potentiometer after calibration.

reset_calibration.title: Remove voltage calibration
reset_calibration.description: The voltage entity will stay unavailable until a new calibration is completed.
